nom: Peter Thomas Roth Retinol Fusion PM Night Serum

avis.texte: using continuously for 5 months every night and absolutely no change in my skin. feels like a dry oil not reel retinol at all. would never buy this product again or waste my time

avis.titre: Retinol Fusion PM Night Serum by Peter Tomas Roth.
avis.texte: I like this Retinol solution as it does slightly help to prevent any further wrinkles. I don't see that it improves the wrinkles that I presently have.

I tried this brand, and found nothing but disappointment. The eye patches are dry, the retinol is mediocre, the eye cream is meh. This serum feels like a dry oil, which is fine, but literally has not done anything for my skin. I have used other retinol, same or even lower price point, which made my skin feel firmer but this does nothing.

I usually am very retinol sensitive (peeling, flakey, dry, painful). I love that I could bath in this and not have a bad reaction ever. But, after using for a few years, I don't feel like I am/have seen any results. I am 46 and still look mid-30s so maybe. But I don't feel like I look any more youthful (collagen plumped) that before I started. I still use it, but am looking around for stronger options and also contemplating the Lancer Method (physical exfoliate, cleanse, nourish/moisturize). It seems to have gotten some awesome results for Candace Cameron Bure.

This serium has been working well so far. Note that it is concentrated, so use it sparingly, use it at night before bed since your skin will need to be protected from the sun the next day with sun screen. Good to use for vertical lines on forehead & in between brows.
Love! Been using this every night. Also use it on my hands. I refuse to look my age lol
The number on my bottle is 22A88. When will it expire. It is unopened. If expired, is it useless? Thanks.
I'm very happy with this product I soon I put it on my face I feel the fresh of the serum going to my pores. Is amazing.
Love this but i will never purchase again, if i do i will be around 65 and i will have win the lottery. Lightweight, proven results and good for sensitive skin.
Im on my 3rd bottle, its worth every penny. No irritation and delivers smoothing results.

I've only used this product for a few weeks so I can't speak to its long term effects, but I can tell you that I noticed SIGNIFICANTLY softer skin on my face only after one day of use. It was incredible, SO soft. The serum has a texture that I really like, it's like oil when you put it on but dries quickly into like a powder feeling and then absorbs into the skin, no lingering oil. However, unfortuantely I just can't get over the "retinol reek". Apparently that's a thing, retinol in general has a very bizarre scent a few hours after it's been applied to the skin (but in the bottle it smells like nothing). Some people (according to Google) say that retinol smells like hotdog water or like dog food lol. I smell it on my hands after application (even after washing them) and the smell is just too much for me. Some products add fragrance to counter the scent, but some don't to spare your skin from potentially irritating components- this one has no added scents. I plan to look for one with the the same kind of texture but with added fragrance.
I definitely see a difference in my skin. Not greasy goes right into your skin. Really like it.

PTR pm serum gave good results. As with most retinol serums your skin must adjust to the product which included the appearance of flaky skin as the skin slouffs the old skin off, even a bit of redness. I took the time needed to let the pm serum work so results weren't immediate, by continuing use my fine lines even the 11 lines diminished. The results were noticeably visible. PTR Retinol Serum contains squalane which I now look for in my skincare regimen. The negative with this product is the dropper bottle, it's pricey and to easy to lose serum as it's liquid PTR makes excellent facial masks & i love the Vitamin C weekly scrub
It doesnt work. Causes acne breakouts not "purging". I returned. Dont buy

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Love it it's a very good product I have to use it all the time

avis.titre: No I would not buy again for 1 reason
avis.texte: The dropper came loose after about 6 uses. I love this stuff so bought another bottle and same thing happened. Which ruins product cause air gets in bottle. A real shame cause that is the only reason I will not buy again.

Im a retinol junky and have tried them all including cheaper drug store brands. I cone back to this one. Its the only one i use every drop of. Worth every penny. Zero iritation, noticable resuction in fone lines and feels great on the skin. Its a dry oil style - perfect to layer under a good nightime moisturizer. Thanks PTR.

I've never had a retinol product before, and I'm so happy that I chose this one. (To preface what I am about to say - I have super oily and acne prone skin, due to PCOS, and have dark spots almost everywhere) I double cleanse my face with a regular gentle cleanser, and then a benzol peroxide cleanser, then go in with the retinol once my face is COMPLETELY dry. I follow that up with niacinamide serum and an Azelaic acid serum, then moisturizer and a face oil. It sounds like a lot, but it's truly not. Plus, if you want to combat the purge stage, then you're obviously going to need to put things on your skin to fight that acne. I've been doing this nightly routine for months, and I've had no purging at all, and no irritation. Results came within the first 2 weeks. I just wish the negative reviewers understood that this isn't an "all in one" product, and needs to be incorporated into a routine.
Just be aware there is a purge stage. I couldn't handle it so I stopped using it. I have to work on getting my skin back on track now.
I love this product. It really helps with the fine lines on the forehead and uneven skintone.

No skin problems, feels good buuuuut it leaked and i lost about a 1/4 of it so a little sad. I think im going to take it in to exchange it cause im cheap and dont want to miss out on having the full amount of product purchasesd. If they add an o ring the seal would have prevented the leakage.

My sensitive skin (face) loves this serum. 3-4 drops is enough for my entire face and neck. I use it nightly and it lasts me over a year, though I toss it because the lifespan is 12-months after you open it. My face is smooth and moisturized. This product doesn't dry out my face. I purchased the jumbo bottle for a friend. Her, her husband, and her daughter all love it. She said their skin looks and feels better. I recommend this for those with sensitive skin.

I've been using this product for a few months now and notice my skin is brighter and more radiant since using. I have a small post acne mark I'm hoping it will help with in a few days. How I Use: mixing the serum with my gel moisturizer and applying the mixture at night. It soaks in and my face gets moisturizer as well, otherwise if you use alone your face will dry out.

I never write reviews but I love this product. I'm 51and use it every night. My skin looks and feels great in the morning, literally overnight results. You don't need to use much and it soaks in quickly. I try a lot of products regularly and this is in my top 3! I have not had any irritation and I do have sensitive skin.

I bought this for my husband — he wanted to give his skin a bit of TLC without a bunch of steps or perfumey products. He uses a super gentle cleanser at night, then applies a few drops of Retinol Fusion PM, and then follows with The Ordinary moisturizer. In the morning he applies the same moisturizer and sometimes sunscreen. In just three weeks of nightly use he's already had *multiple* comments on the improved tone, clarity, suppleness and glow of his skin! Such a super-simple routine and so effective. This retinol serum absorbs so quickly and easily. I've converted him to a skincare guy!
After one night's application, I noticed an immediate improvement the next morning. My skin was brighter and my hormonal acne began to clear up.
I have been using this product for years and will continue to do so. It is the only product that keeps my skin bright and even. Just always wear sunscreen during the day to protect your skin!
Totally Obsessed! I love the consistency and how it feels. It doesn't bother my sensitive skin.

This is far the best retinol serum you can use for textured skin. I had very textured skin and it has improved dramatically in the last couple years. But you have to be committed to a rigorous daily skincare routine to get the best results. Just like being committed to going to the gym daily to be fit and healthy to get results; a skin gym for your face to get results. I love all PTR products but far this is my fave and part of my skin care routine. I like to use it with my red light therapy wand which I use three times a week and follow up with a good moisturizer.

I really wanted to love this, but my skin literally freaked out on this serum! Be careful, I legit got an allergic reaction to it. Wish I could return it, because it's really not worth the money - not for me at least!
Wasn't a fan...used for 3 weeks and really couldn't tell any improvement in my skin in the slightest. :( Returned:(

My sister had a small bottle of this in our bathroom and I decided to try it one night. I'm so glad I did. Probably the best retinol I've used this far. I loved it so much, I bought a big bottle for myself! When using retinol, you have to start slow! I always make sure I use a really good face oil when I use it and I've had 0 issues with over drying or redness. If you know what you're doing, I definitely recommend this!

I use this daily at night after cleansing my skin. This retinol product is not drying to my skin as other retinols have been and I am convinced it is helpful with wrinkles. I have been using it about 5 years and will continue to use it.

I used 2% retinol serum from SkinCeuticals and it was to strong and to drying so my skin never looked fresh and healthy really. I started with this serum 10 days ago and im so pleased and glad that I got it..its so smooth and moisturizing. My skin has no blemishes or redness as it used to with ceuticals. I highly recommend this product.

I've been using this product for quite some time now and it's one of the only products that I absolutely won't skip. I had a lot of texture to my skin (those annoying little bumps that weren't really zits) and this completely eliminated that. It also sinks into my skin really well and just feels so soft and smooth. It is worth every penny for retinol users who want a good product and a bottle lasts for a long time. I use half a dropper and it saturates my face completely, it's been months since I've had to restock. If you're considering buying this absolutely go for it!!
Best Retinol I have used. Absorbs fast and leaves my skin feeling soft.
This product just works for me. I try other less expensive products, but always come back.

I've used tons of PTR products, but this is hands down the best product I've ever used. This is the one part of my nightly routine I will never skip. I used this years ago, but couldn't continue because of the cost. I was finally able to purchase it again and yet again have seen amazing results in the texture of my acne prone and acne scarred skin. So grateful for this magic in a bottle and I hope I never have to go without it again!!

I bought this as my first retinol, my esthetician recommended getting it to help with my texture! It feels really good on but I break out after each use, I want to love it so bad but my skin wasn't nearly this bad before starting this product.

When I use this product consistently with The Ordinary's Niacinamide, I notice a huge, positive change in my skin. However, PTR is not a cruelty-free brand so I can't bring myself to continue using it after I'm done with my first bottle. Therefore, only a 2 star rating.

It takes practice to get used to using this just because of the consistency but it's worth it because that's also a reason I think this works so well. When I rub it into my skin, it's so silky, not greasy and sinks in so well after a few minutes. It's gentle enough around my eye area and because of the consistency, layers well with other skincare care products. I love this! I don't usually leave reviews but I've actually seen results with this one, I had to. I'm 46 , My texture is improved, wrinkles are smoother, skin is more toned in appearance. I will keep this in my skincare routine for as long as they keep selling it❤️💯👌

I bought this for my husband as hes always commenting on my skincare regime. I personally use retinA but he didnt want to go that hard core and this was the next best thing. It's simple to use and the little dropper that comes with it makes it very easy to apply without wasting too much. It's not greasy and and absorbs quickly into the skin. A little goes a long way.

If you are looking to start using a retinol serum and your skin is dry, this is a great choice. Since starting to use this serum about 2 weeks ago, I've seen a significant improvement in my skin's tone and texture, as well as softening lines and wrinkles. I've used retinol in the past, and it can be irritating, but even at 1.5% retinol, this serum is much more gentle than I thought it would be. And, it's hydrating, too, so if your skin is dry like mine, I think you'll like it. I use 4-5 drops per application after cleansing and before night cream.

This is an amazing product and I would highly recommend it to anyone with some experience with retinol. I don't know if it could be potentially irritating for someone that is trying retinols for the first time.
Have wanted to try this, and it does not disappoint. It is very silky and hydrating, and the retinol is non-irritating. I use it at night after cleansing, letting it fully absorb before night cream.
Feels like a very light luxurious oil! It significantly reduced my mild hormonal acne, hyperpigmentation and appearance of fine lines for both my husband and I. We think it's worth the money.

avis.titre: This is I the best OTC Retinol product around!
avis.texte: I have been using this I product for about 1 1/2 years and am completely sold on it. This is worth trying out for yourself.

When I was younger I had awful skin nothing ever worker even products the doctor prescribed. I am 25 now and I am so thankful my skin has cleared. Now I aim crazy about face products and this is the best. I will continually order this until they quit making these drops. ❤️
I use it couple days a week and I absolutely love it,my skin got smother and some of the hyperpigmentation fading.

I've been using this for a little over a month now. I don't really any wrinkles but I wanted something to help keep wrinkles away and also brighten my complexion. I was told my skin might go through a purging stage and break out. The first few times I used this I noticed old acne scars were fading and it was brightening my skin. Then I started breaking out. I figured it would be like this for about a week or 2 while all my impurities were coming to the surface. It's been about 5 weeks now and the acne won't stop and it keeps getting worse and worse. It's so wired because once old acne clears up they fade away so fast besucase of this product but it also cause so many new breakouts and I don't really break out normally... I think this product is breaking me out because I have dry skin especially in the winter. So I think using this product is stripping too much moisture out of my skin

I've tried other retinol products and this one works the best for me. We all have different chemical make ups so it may not work for everyone, but I love how it is a serum and not a cream as serums penetrate the skin and creams act as a barrier!

I've been using this and his Unwrinkle creams (usually the night one) for years. His products are the best. I had been using a citrus brand of makeup wipes that actually dried my skin so badly that my cheeks were wrinkled. This saved me. Within a few weeks my wrinkles were gone. There is no terrible scent, it's easy to use. I sometimes just use the serum at night and sometimes just the Unwrinkle cream. I alternate instead of layering to save a little money. I also love his retinol fusion pads that you wipe on your face, neck, hands and chest and leave it in overnight. I have slightly dry skin. My skin is sensitive and these products are gentle and they give the amounts of ingredients which most products do not. I've noticed his products are getting harder to find and am not happy.
Have Use this product for a few years but my last bottle begin to zap the moisture from my face. The consultant at Ulta recommended I stopped using it immediately it is too strong and too drying.

I have very acne prone skin and I'm also very sensitive. When I started wearing makeup my acne really came out. My mom let me use her bottle and it works MIRACLES. The next day my acne was almost gone. You can use it as an area treatment or all over your face.It smells a bit weird, but not bad. You don't have to be older to use this, I'm on the younger side and it doesn't irritate my skin. I use this every night with my Clinique moisturizer and differen gel. Even though it can be a but spendy, it is totally worth it!
I have been using this product for several years and consider it an important part of my skin care routine.

I almost made it through the entire bottle before my nighttime routine fell off and I slowly stopped using this. Huge mistake for my skin - I started breaking out and scarring. Immediately started using this again as it's the one thing that would keep me bright, even toned, and relatively breakout free. So excited to get back into using this regularly again and to save my skin.
very disappointed.liquid..does not soak in liquid..does not soak in.no results

Bought this because reviews said it helped with acne and aging. Even though I am in my 60's I still get small white bumps. This has eliminated them. It also helped with fine lines and evened my skin tone. It goes on very oily but is quickly absorbed. You only need a very small amount. I just fill the end of the dropper and apply with my head tipped back and then rub it in, keeping hair off my face until it is absorbed. Worth the price and the bottle should last quite awhile.

I really wanted to love this product from all the good reviews I've read about it but it made me break out extremely bad. At first I thought it was because I was introducing a new product. However, a month later and my face was worse than when I started using this. All skin types are different and you need to find out what works best for your skin and unfortunately this didn't work with mine.

This is my first retinol serum to try. I love the way my skin looks the morning after I use it. My skin is brighter and more even, and my discolored spots are a little more faded. My only complaint is the consistency. It's very thin, much like water, so it's hard to control where it applies
Was nervous to buy this product because of the price, but it was worth every penny. I have oily skin and large pores, this has worked wonders and really makes my skin glow.

I got a sample of this year's ago and thought "I don't need/want this!" Anyway, I for some reason tried it and all of my acne disappeared. I'm still relatively young, only 31, so I don't have a lot of wrinkles, so I can't really speak to how it works on wrinkles, but it totally works on acne. Give it a shot. And only use at night.

avis.titre: Absolutely in love with this prodcut
avis.texte: This product absorbs quickly and non-greasy, I use it at night layered with other Peter Thomas Roth products. I did see a difference overnight with skin texture. I noticed my skin was soft, smooth and youthful looking. It took about a 2 or 3 weeks before I saw a difference in my already barely noticeable fine lines on my forehead and between my eyes. Now, they are almost completely gone. I'm hopeful that with continued use, they will completely disappear.

The salesperson told me I would see results with this overnight. I did not expect that, but after a month, I did expect to see something. This feels nice going on the skin and a little drop goes a long way, but it was not a game changer for me. I am 59, have excellent and well cared for skin and maybe it's as good as it's going to get, no matter what I use. But this was a waste of money and I'm disappointed.
I used daily at night... my fines lines disappeared and my skin feels so soft .. excellent product.

avis.titre: I'm not a reviewer, but I found the time to write one!
avis.texte: This is the best serum I've ever used in my life. I have tried everything under the sun. I've been using this product for about 2 months now and this will never not leave my side. It helps with skin texture so much. I used to breakout on my smile lines, lots of dry dead skin accumulated around there. With PTR Retinol Fusion alllll of that has stopped. I've also noticed a difference in my acne scars. They are lighter and less noticeable.

avis.titre: Not sure why no one is talking about this
avis.texte: I have fallen in love with this product! I see my skin visibly smoother and less break outs than before. It's also brighter! Definitely grabbing a full size after going through a trial size. A little goes a long way with this stuff too, definitely worth the money!

I am VERY into skin care and take the products I use very seriously. I can honestly say that this is the most effective product I own and is worth every single penny. I will continue to buy over and over!! It literally makes your face instantly feel like SILK and feels amazing while putting on. I have more dry side skin and get that nasty flaking under foundations, so I use some of this in the morning as well if I am extra dry.

I have strange skin. Rosacea and a whole host of other issues. I didn't think this was doing much for me after a couple of months, and stopped using. Then I realized that it had made a difference after I stopped. It was subtle for me, but it did make my skin look better. Mainly what I notice is that my skin looks better in the morning. I don't feel the need to rush and put on makeup. It looks more even and not as red and blotchy in the morning. Also, it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I would recommend and will repurchase.

I haven't been using this long enough to know if it delivers results however I don't doubt that it won't. After applying, it takes a few seconds to dry but my skin is SO soft after use. I use a little (a little goes a long way) under my eyes, along my laugh lines and across my forehead. Love the way it feels on my skin.
Girls, you can't live without this!!! I love this product and i've tried everything. I apply it at night, wait 5 minutes then my night cream! Huge difference

avis.titre: Helped get rid of my cystic acne scars!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product! I've been using it for about 3 weeks and I'm not even a quarter through the 200 mL bottle. I've struggled with cystic acne during my pregnancies and I stupidly would pick pick pick! I haven't found anything to help subside the marks but this product has increased my skin tone, complexion, and overall smoothness of my face. I'm sure that when this bottle is eventually gone my scarring will no longer be visible. It's super expensive, but well worth it. Fillers and peels are also expensive so it's all relative. I highly recommend this product for people who have struggled with acne, wrinkles and dry skin. It's the best.

I got this in the PTR Power Players set. This by far has been the most gentle retinol I've ever used! A little goes a long way. I have oily, 40+ year old skin (with major breakouts in my 30's) and this has been so great to my skin's texture. Will purchase again!

avis.titre: I'll Continue to Buy this as long as PTR Makes it
avis.texte: This retinol is the most gentle retinol out there. It has microencapsulated retinol, which means that this serum doesn't hit your skin all at once with retinol. Rather, it releases the retinol over an 8 hour period. I have a scar from a horribly big cystic acne episode in my 20's. I'm 50 now. After using this serum for approximately a year, that indented scar has completely filled in. I believe in retinol. Period. This retinol, in my opinion, has worked on a "next level" of greatness. I'm a huge fan of PTR's products. This is probably my favorite. Yes, the price is steep. However, you'll have this product for months. I use it nightly.

avis.titre: So far seems like it's working
avis.texte: Haven't even used for a month now! Should have taken pics. But it is rather runny so I don't even use the top of the dropper to squeeze drops out I just let the liquid drip onto my fingers then rub onto all areas of my face including under the eye area. Doesn't cause any reactions, no acne breakouts, no sensitivity! Absorbs moderately. Follow w the PTR toning lotion and unwrinkle turbo, and night

avis.titre: Where have you been all of my life
avis.texte: I'm totally in love with PTR products. This one is probably my absolute fave (along with the eye cream, gotta have both!) and it should be in every womans nightly skin regimen. I'm 43 and I get told I look 35 years old and sometimes younger. The fine lines on my face are disappearing and I cannot tell you how happy I am that the crows feet around my eyes have reduced to only a few! Omg and you can even use it on your hands! I am using it on my hands because I feel like the backs of my hands look so old. The product seems oily but once you put it on it soaks right in and works all night long. No greasy face and definitely no oily pillow case.
Goes easy and smooth. Feels great on face. No irritation at all!

avis.titre: I hope this is still as good as it used to be!
avis.texte: I love love love the PTR Retinol Fusion PM. This is probably my 10th bottle. I've noticed that it is thicker than it used to be, so I hope they haven't changed anything else.
I rarely give reviews on anything but I really like this product. I use it a couple times a week in the evening then apply my moisturizer. My skin feels great and no one believes I am 65 years old!
Because I used to tan a lot I had some fine lines on my forehead well this stuff literally blurred them but you have to be consistent in using it!

A little goes a long way!! It seems expensive but you just need a little to cover your face. I have only used this twice and I can already see a brighter complexion. It absorbs very well and does not feel heavy on your skin. It leaves your skin very soft and my pores are smaller already. The under eye cream is just as wonderful! Highly recommended this product!!
This is my 3rd bottle. It works for me plus the bottle lasts for months I highly recommend it
Love this night serum. It helps even fine lines and wrinkles like no other!

I am 35, have fair and very dry skin. I'm a non smoker and have never been a sun worshiper. Unfortunately, my fair skin still has its fair share of discoloration and my tiny pores as a teenager have started to enlarge with age. In the past I used prescription retinols and those would always irritate my sensitive skin and make me unbelievably dry even though I use great moisturizers. I bought this along with PTR Unwrinkle Peel Pads and within just two weeks I've noticed my enlarged pores are non existent! I haven't noticed any change in the discoloration yet. This does not dry my skin out. It actually gives it a glow that I absolutely love!

avis.titre: This product makes my skin feel young again
avis.texte: nightly use helps to remove the orange peel look caused by sun/wind damage.

I bought this serum for the first time back in January and I am on my second bottle already. It makes my skin feel like no other nightly treatment, it's very silky, smooth, and makes my skin glow. It has also cleared up my acne marks. Great product.
This made me break out ANyWHERE I applied like a trail of acne. I do not have sensitive skin but to this I did have an awful reaction to it.

I finally finished the bottle and I can honestly say that i saw no change whatsoever. My lines and sun spots look exactly the same. I also didn't like that it took so long to soak into the skin. I had to wait a while before layering other products on top. I won't be repurchasing.
This formula feels so soft and amazing when you apply it to your skin, I love it.

I tend to do a lot of homework before trying anything new after developing sensitivities to many common skincare ingredients and now random fragrances. I also don't want to settle for mediocre skincare, so I look for products with shorter ingredient lists & actives toward the top. This sounded ideal for my oily skin and large pores prone to clogged blackheads and whiteheads, so I was glad to find it as gentle as described with no drying at all. After a month, my pores were virtually clear and my skin was brighter. I've now used it almost nightly for 4+ months and it's become one of few products I can't imagine being without. This has the consistency of water and dries quickly with no pilling, so it's nice to be able to apply serum, moisturizer(s), etc over it within minutes. It also lasts forever since only a few drops are needed each night. I don't have many wrinkles other than a moderately-deep crease below each eye, but no change in either since starting this, so I'll likely try another PTR product with a higher percentage of retinol to see if that makes a difference. If you have sensitive skin and/or don't want to deal with the dryness & peeling associated with other retinol products, I definitely recommend giving this one a try. Tip- it's very thin, so use the dropper to place a drop on each part of your face, then quickly smooth it in. (I tried using my hands, but it mainly ended up down my arms and on the counter.)
I use it twice a day, in the morning before I apply other treatments and at night after I wash my face before going to bed.
I use with 2 other PTR products. I was never good with routine. But now seeing a change, this is my routine.
The first time I used this product I absolutely fell in love. Application is so easy and makes your skin feel silky and smooth. My skin feels so much healthier only after a week's use.

I flocked to Peter Thomas Roth because of problems I was having with acne. I had previously used retinol in other products recommended to me by a dermatologist, and decided to give this a shot. I really didn't find that this was any more effective than any serum I've used. I really couldn't notice a difference in my skin tone, appearance, and acne. After months of using it I just stopped before the bottle was empty and moved on to other products.

I had never used retinol prior to purchasing this, but had always heard amazing things. Knowing what retinol does I wanted a good one so I invested in this serum. Im so happy I made this purchase and will definitely do so again when I run out.

avis.titre: I love it, but my daughter bought it for me,
avis.texte: I love it and the 24 cart sample that came with it. My daughter purchased it for me so i hope when it runs out i can afford it again

avis.titre: Great Addition to Night Time Routine
avis.texte: I have been wanting to add this to my night time skincare routine for a while. I finally gave in after doing much research and convincing myself I needed this. I am approaching my 30s and figured this would help with the appearance or prevention of fine lines and rinkles. The application is easy though I switched from putting drops on my hand to just applying directly onto my face and massaging it in. The formula seems to absorb quick so you do not want to take your time applying it. Overall I am seeing results in the appearance of my skin. I know I do not have many fine lines and rinkles yet so I am doing this as preventative maintenance.

avis.titre: I haven't been using it for very long, but, so far so good!
avis.texte: Not cheap, but, as long as I keep seeing an improvement-worth every penny.

I have used PTR retinol for several years. It makes my skin soft, helps with the lines and it glows. I use it for several weeks and then stop and use it again the next month. You can use on a regular basis only at night. it does not irritate my skin.

Wanted to add retinol into my skin routine in my late 20's and this is perfect. I'm able to use it every night with no redness or skin irritation. I've noticed changes in my skin such as improved texture--leaves my skin clearer and smooth in the morning

I use this every night. it doesn't dry out my skin. I love the consistency. you put it on and it feels like a light oil but quickly absorbs into my skin and is ready for me to put my moisturizer on top. no greasy mess, and it lasts forever. I absolutely love this product. I use it every night and it really has improved the look and feel of my skin. I have old acne scarring, some discoloration, and an uneven texture. This has helped so much with making my skin smoother and more even toned. I think retinol is a must and this has a lot of it compared to a lot of other products. It soaks in quickly so instead of dropping it onto my fingers first, I drop it directly on my forehead, each cheek, and chin, and then rub it in all over my face. This is a staple that I don't mind spending the money on because it actually works. I will definitely continue buying it!

This product is extremely effective at boosting cell turnover and collagen synthesis! At the same time it's extremely unlikely that you'll experience any irritation. The serum formula is very soothing and balances the effects of the 1.5% retinol. I'd recommend this above any other available option in the OTC market. Great for the newbie to retinol or the experienced user. Use only at night and be sure to follow with a good SPF for the day.

I was really excited to try this product, given the great reviews. I had been using retinol products for about a year now and really liked how they help control my adult acne. I don't know if it's the formulation or what, but this product created an absolute nightmare for my skin. I had huge, painful, cystic acne in some places and peeling in others. At first I told myself I was purging due to the strength of the product- then my husband finally convinced me that it was making things worse. When I stopped using the product, my skin started to heal- but it was a slow process, and I still have hyper-pigmentation and scarring. I love other PTR products, but this one obviously did't jive with my skin. Thank goodness for Ulta's awesome return policy!

After just 5 days I've noticed a huge difference in my skins overall appearance. I'm looking forward to seeing the results after an extended use of time. I like the texture of the product. A little bit goes a long way.
